# Mago Vituco Productions

> International magic and live entertainment production for cruise ships and ferries, drawing on more than 15 years of maritime entertainment experience.

Mago Vituco Productions offers large-scale theatrical illusions, self-contained guest entertainer magic shows, close-up magic, and interactive magic and origami workshops for passengers. Formats are adapted to onboard operations and fly-on/fly-off scheduling.
